In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)=\operatorname{csch}⁡x$ and $v(x)={3}^{x}.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{(\operatorname{csch}⁡x)}^{′}\cdot {3}^{x}-\operatorname{csch}⁡x\cdot {({3}^{x})}^{′}}{{({3}^{x})}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{(-\operatorname{csch}⁡x\operatorname{coth}⁡x)\cdot {3}^{x}-\operatorname{csch}⁡x\cdot ({3}^{x}\operatorname{ln}⁡3)}{{3}^{2x}} \\  & =-\frac{{3}^{x}\operatorname{csch}⁡x(\operatorname{coth}⁡x+\operatorname{ln}⁡3)}{{3}^{2x}} \\  & =-\frac{\operatorname{csch}⁡x(\operatorname{coth}⁡x+\operatorname{ln}⁡3)}{{3}^{x}}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
